Question: How do I track my order?
Answer: You can track your order in real-time by visiting My Orders > Track Shipment or clicking the tracking link sent to your SMS and email.

Question: Where is my parcel?
Answer: Your parcel status and live location are updated under My Orders section. You can check expected delivery date there.

Question: How do I cancel my order?
Answer: Go to My Orders, select the specific item, and click Cancel Order before it has been dispatched for delivery.

Question: Can I cancel my shipment?
Answer: Yes, you can cancel your shipment directly from the My Orders dashboard prior to order dispatch.

Question: What is the return policy?
Answer: You can initiate a return within 7 days of delivery for eligible electronic items if they are defective, damaged, or unboxed incorrectly.

Question: How can I return my order?
Answer: To return an order, navigate to My Orders, tap Return/Replace, select the reason for return, and schedule a pickup.

Question: When will I get my refund?
Answer: Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after the returned item passes quality inspection at our warehouse.

Question: What payment methods are supported?
Answer: We accept Credit/Debit cards, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, EMI, and Cash on Delivery (COD).

Question: Is international shipping available?
Answer: Currently we only ship across domestic pin codes within India. International shipping is coming soon.

Question: How do I claim product warranty?
Answer: Warranty can be claimed directly at any authorized brand service center using the invoice downloaded from My Orders.

Question: Are there any shipping charges?
Answer: Standard delivery is completely free for orders above 499 INR. Express next-day shipping incurs an optional fee of 99 INR.
